description: This file is a shell script that contains functions for interacting with git tags, commits, and author information. It includes functions for verifying tags, creating commits, updating references, replacing SHA1 hashes, setting author info, handling commit dates, and testing outputs.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Verifies the existence of a git tag and throws an error if not found.

methods.name: unique_commit
methods.description: Generates a unique git commit using specified text, tree, and tags.

methods.name: save_tag
methods.description: Updates a tag reference and modifies a sed script with the new tag name.

methods.name: entag
methods.description: Replaces unhelpful sha1 hashes with symbolic names using sed script.

methods.name: as_author
methods.description: Executes a command with a specified GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL, restoring the original after execution.

methods.name: commit_date
methods.description: Retrieves the commit date for a given commit SHA.

methods.name: assign_fake_date
methods.description: Assigns a fake date to a variable, defaulting to '1971-08-16' when needed.

methods.name: on_committer_date
methods.description: Runs a command with a specified fake committer date.

methods.name: on_dates
methods.description: Runs a command with specified fake author and committer dates.

methods.name: hide_error
methods.description: Runs a command suppressing any error output.

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Compares command output to an expected value, using entag to replace hashes.

methods.name: name_from_description
methods.description: Converts a description string into a sanitized test name.

methods.name: test_output_expect_success
methods.description: Performs a test expecting specific output from a command.
